title: Incorporating Neuro-developmental Conditions in Existing Tiered-care Mental Health Model to Ensure Holistic Care
what_it_is: Incorporating Neuro-developmental Conditions in Existing Tiered-care Mental Health Model to Ensure Holistic Care

sections.label: Tiered mental health care services
sections.summary: The tiered-care model is organised by severity and complexity, not diagnoses, and offers community and specialist services with subsidies for those with neuro-developmental conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The current tiered-care model is organised by severity and complexity of mental health needs, not specific diagnoses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: And so, it applies to individuals with ADHD and autism who have co-occurring mental health needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In the community, such individuals can access free or subsidised services like the Response, Early Intervention and Assessment in Community Mental Health (REACH) for children, the Centre of Excellence for Youth Mental Health in Singapore (CHAT) for adolescents and young adults, and the Community Integrated Health Team (CIHT) by Happee Hearts Movement for adults.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Specialist psychiatric services are also available at our public Specialist Outpatient Clinics (SOCs) where eligible patients, including those with neuro-developmental conditions, can receive means-tested subsidies of up to 70%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Those who still face difficulties paying for their bills, can approach medical social workers at our public healthcare institutions for assistance such as MediFund.

sections.label: National Mental Health Office collaboration
sections.summary: The National Mental Health Office collaborates with social partners and would help strengthen their capabilities, while counsellors refer clients with suspected depression for specialist assessments.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The National Mental Health Office has a collaboration and close interaction with many of our social partners that provide some of these services in the community.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: If they feel that there are areas in which they need to be strengthened in terms of capabilities, we would be happy to work with them to conduct awareness courses for them.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But generally, I think our more experienced counsellors that are providing services to these clients with neuro-developmental needs, if they do feel that there is something beyond what they can handle, if they feel that there is an element of co-occurring mental illnesses like depression, for example, I think they, being from a counselling background, will pick up on depression because they have dealt with other non-neuro-developmental clients in other aspects of their work as well.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: And if they do detect some elements of depression, we would encourage them to refer onwards for specialist assessments.
